title: Spec item 5 says the migration is ONE additive column but it ships two (corrected_name + corrected_at)
evidence:
5. **`supabase/migrations/`** (expand-only, ONE additive column): `corrected_name TEXT` —
   the §8.3 edit-trio has a Name field; A1's corrected-* pattern extended (snapshot still
   immutable). Everything else exists since rc2-1.
(actual migration 20260812140000_reference_call_corrected_name.sql: ALTER TABLE reference_call
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS corrected_name TEXT,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS corrected_at TIMESTAMPTZ;)
detail: Drift introduced by the r1 rework: corrected_at (the W3 exhaustion-gate timestamp) landed in the migration but spec Scope item 5 was not updated, so the spec contradicts both the migration and its own Dev Agent Record (which mentions corrected_at).
